chapter: Ellington colleagues, singers and world tours
title: Why Ivie Anderson left; Jean Eldridge
summary: Brown thinks Ivie's husband pushed for more money, and Jean Eldridge sang I Want Something to Live For.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: (inaudible). Why did Ivy leave the band?

Why? I really don't know. I think her husband requested that she get more money and wanted her to get more money, and that was unheard of. So I think he had her pull out. She had some property here in L. A., and she really didn't need to struggle along like that. But when she pulled out, she went sort of a single, you know, during a stint in cabarets and -- as a single.
Jean, I have never heard of Jean since she made that record with us. She was the one that made 'I Want Something to Live For', Jean Eldridge -- very fine, very

fine. I don't know why she quit or why she changed over, but we never heard much more of Jean. She was originally from Buffalo, I think, and I don't know whether she just wanted to go home or whether she had some differences with the powers that be or what.
